crossRefs.note: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.
“Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
For I have heard the defaming of many, “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar…
You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”
“Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of…
Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have…
The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…

translations.web: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
translations.bsb: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
translations.kjv: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
translations.asv: They are all grievous revolters, going about with slanders; they are brass and iron: they all of them deal corruptly.
